message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Clarifying llama.cpp HTTP server's file upload behavior and reproducibility challenges","body":"I've come across a 2025 Reddit post discussing the file upload button in llama.cpp's HTTP server and its interaction with prompts. The author wonders if uploading a file simply concatenates its contents with the direct prompt, but this isn't confirmed. They report mixed results when querying the file's contents—sometimes the model answers questions correctly, other times it seems to interpret the file content itself rather than the query. They used llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_S and aimed for reproducible outputs, meaning consistent answers when restarting conversations with the same prompts. However, reproducibility was inconsistent. Given these observations, does anyone have insights into how exactly the file upload feature integrates with the prompt? Also, are there recommended strategies or settings to improve reproducibility when querying uploaded files through the HTTP server? In 15 tests, sometimes the model correctly answered questions about the file, but other times it seemed to respond based on the file contents themselves rather than the query. They used llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_S and sought reproducible answers across new conversations, but results varied. Given this, what is known about how the file upload button actually works under the hood?
